channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Imperial Japanese Army secretly considered martial law in 1945, document says
item.description: The considerations were made during the final stages of World War II amid concerns that U.S. air raids would severely disrupt public order.

item.title: Asian Games put spotlight on cricket’s growth in Japan
item.description: The ongoing Games and a historic contest against India are giving cricket an opportunity to add to its steady growth.

item.title: Typhoon Dujuan leaves at least nine dead and four missing near Tokyo
item.description: Chiba Prefecture reported six deaths while Kanagawa Prefecture reported three as of 8 a.m. Wednesday. Two people are missing in each prefecture.

item.title: Takaichi holds first talks with Zelenskky, but no mention of defense cooperation
item.description: The Ukrainian leader did not publicly broach the possibility of tieups with Tokyo such as in the area of drone development and air defense equipment.

item.title: More teen magic in Asian Games pool as Kojima thrills Japan
item.description: The 17-year-old Yumeki Kojima's triumph in the men's 400-meter individual medley set a Games record of 4 minutes, 7.02 seconds.

item.title: Embraer nears regional jet order from Japan Airlines in blow to Airbus
item.description: The carrier, which has been weighing whether to order Embraer's E2 or Airbus's A220, is due to make a final decision as soon as October, sources said.

item.title: Indonesia to develop earthquake early warning system with Japan’s help
item.description: Indonesia plans to conduct trial runs for the envisioned warning system in Jakarta and some other regions by 2030.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: Four dead after powerful Typhoon Dujuan lashes Japan
item.description: The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.
